sn37.8:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.8:1.3: assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottāpī ca hoti, maccharī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti.
sn37.8:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā
